status_legend.SV: verified in Copilot Rust SDK source at the pinned commit (linked)
status_legend.INF: harness design defined in this spec (intentional, not an SDK fact)
status_legend.UNV: depends on SDK behaviour not yet verified; see the probe list
status_legend.CLIENT: computed or held only in the UI
status_legend.SAMPLE: illustrative mockup data, not produced by any API

entries.shows: One row per orchestration run, newest first, grouped under Recent and under the repository.
entries.source: Harness run index `GET /api/runs` → `{run_id, title, repo_root, updated_seq, live_agents}`. `title` = title of the approved plan, else the first user message cut to 60 chars.
entries.action: Click opens the run (client navigation). Only the first run in the mockup has data; the others are sample rows (X1).

entries.element: Live-agent count on the run row ("3 live")
entries.shows: Number of agents that are not finished.
entries.source: Count of `AgentRecord` whose `status` is not `completed | failed | cancelled | crashed`.

entries.shows: Every agent of the run with a status glyph and its first task id (or 'lead').
entries.source: `AgentRecord{id, parent, depth, tasks, status}` ordered by depth then spawn seq. Glyph = display status D1. Right label = lowest `TaskId` in `tasks`, or 'lead' for the orchestrator.
entries.action: Click focuses that agent's transcript (client).

entries.shows: Repository name.
entries.source: Basename of `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` for the run's `repo_root`.

entries.shows: Branch of each writing agent's worktree, coloured by agent.
entries.source: `AgentRecord.workspace = Worktree{path, branch, base_commit}`; reconciled against `git worktree list --porcelain` at harness start.
entries.action: Click opens the Worktrees tab (G1, G2).

entries.shows: Whether the single Copilot CLI child process is up and how many agent sessions it hosts.
entries.source: Process up = `Client::pid()` returns `Some` (SV); exits are observed on `Client::subscribe_lifecycle()` (SV); liveness is `Client::ping` every 30 s (SV). Session count = agents whose `CopilotBinding` is live (harness). RSS is read by the harness supervisor from the OS for that pid; session workspace sizes come from `rpc().sessions().get_sizes()` (SV). At 3 GiB RSS the item shows the memory step in progress: closing idle sessions, then 'recycle pending' (section 4.4).

entries.shows: Placeholders in the mockup.
entries.source: New session = harness command `create_run`. History and search are client views over S1.

entries.shows: Run title; when an agent is focused, the parent chain ending in that agent.
entries.source: Run title (S1). Breadcrumb = `AgentRecord.parent` chain of the focused agent.
entries.action: Clicking a crumb focuses that agent (client).

entries.shows: Repository, base branch of the run with ahead / behind counts, and the short id of the lead's Copilot session.
entries.source: Branch = `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` in `repo_root`. Session id = `Session::id()` of the orchestrator's current generation (first 8 chars). Ahead / behind = `git rev-list --left-right --count origin/<branch>...HEAD`.

entries.shows: Agent kind and its task id and title. The status bar shows its worktree branch in the same view.
entries.source: `AgentRecord.kind`, board `Task{id, title}` for its first task, `Workspace` branch or 'main (read-only)'.

entries.shows: Agents currently doing or blocked on something.
entries.source: Count of agents whose display status D1 is `running | needs_permission | needs_answer | waiting_on_agents`.
entries.action: Opens the Agents tab of the run panel.

entries.shows: Items that wait on the user.
entries.action: Focuses the lead transcript and scrolls to the first open card (C11, C12, C13).

entries.element: Context gauge in the stats line
entries.shows: Context window used by the focused agent's current Copilot session, as a 270° gauge with a tick at its compaction threshold D11. The arc and percentage shift from grey to amber over the 15 points below the tick and stay amber above it.
entries.source: D5 = `current_tokens / token_limit` of the latest `session.usage_info`. Tick position and colour ramp come from D11 (0.80 for the 200K windows in the sample).
entries.action: Click opens the breakdown H11.

entries.shows: Name of the provider profile the target agent's session uses.
entries.source: Harness config profile → `SessionConfig.provider: ProviderConfig{provider_type, base_url, api_key, wire_api, …}` (SV). Each model call reports `assistant.usage.is_byok` (SV), which the harness can assert. Keys are never sent to the UI.

entries.shows: Light or dark theme.
entries.source: Client preference only.

entries.shows: Mockup-only overlay that labels every element with its wiring id.
entries.source: Exists only in this mockup; not part of the product.

entries.shows: Simulates losing the harness stream so the connection banner C26 can be seen.
entries.source: Exists only in this mockup; not part of the harness API. The outage lasts about 12 s, so the third automatic retry succeeds.
entries.action: Click drops the simulated link; click again ('Restore link') reconnects at once.

entries.shows: For the focused agent: tokens in context out of the window, split into system, tools, history and files on one bar with ticks at D11 and 95%, and how far the session is from compaction. The numbers in the mockup are sample data (X1).
entries.source: The latest `session.usage_info{current_tokens, token_limit, system_tokens, tool_definitions_tokens, conversation_tokens}` of the agent's current generation (SV). System = `system_tokens`. Tools = `tool_definitions_tokens`. Files = the harness's estimate of file content still in context: read-tool results and attachments since the last compaction, at about 4 bytes per token, capped at `conversation_tokens` (INF). History = `conversation_tokens` − Files, plus any gap between the four parts and `current_tokens`. Compaction point = D11 × `token_limit`.
entries.action: 'All agents' opens the Agents tab, where each agent row (A2) has the same meter. Escape or a click outside closes it and returns focus to H6.

entries.shows: Switches between the conversation layout and the Code view (W1–W6). The run, the focused agent and the composer stay the same.
entries.source: Client state.
entries.action: Code puts the editor in the middle and the chat on the right; the run panel is hidden until you switch back.

entries.shows: Whether the sidebar and the run panel are visible.
entries.source: Client state.
entries.action: Click toggles. In the Code view the panel toggle switches back to Chat.

entries.shows: How many older events of the focused agent are not loaded, and a control to page them in.
entries.source: `GET /api/runs/{run}/events?agent={id}&before_seq={first_loaded}&limit=200`, served from the harness log via its sparse index. Never served from Copilot `Session::get_events()`, which loads a whole timeline into memory.
entries.action: Loads one page and prepends it (client keeps at most E3 events).

entries.shows: Text the user sent to the focused agent, with time.
entries.source: Harness `user_message` event when the UI command is accepted. The Copilot echo `user.message{content, delivery, message_id}` (SV) confirms it entered the session.

entries.shows: Agent name, role pill, model.
entries.source: Name and role from `AgentRecord`. Model from `assistant.message.model` or `assistant.usage.model` (SV).

entries.shows: First line of the model's reasoning for the turn, expandable.
entries.source: `assistant.reasoning{reasoning_id, content}`; streamed as `assistant.reasoning_delta{reasoning_id, delta_content}`. Present only if the BYOK provider and model emit reasoning (provider-dependent).

entries.shows: One row per tool call: icon, verb, argument summary, duration.
entries.source: Row opens on `tool.execution_start{tool_call_id, tool_name, tool_title, arguments, shell_tool_info.display_command}` and closes on `tool.execution_complete{tool_call_id, success, error, file_edits}`. Verb = harness table keyed by `tool_name`; built-in names are read at runtime from `rpc().tools().get_builtin_descriptors()` (method SV, names UNV, probe V8). Argument = `tool_title`, else `display_command`, else first path in `arguments`. Duration = difference of the two envelopes' `SessionEvent.timestamp`. '+N −M' on edit rows comes from D9.

entries.shows: The assistant's reply, rendered as markdown.
entries.source: Final text = `assistant.message{message_id, content}`. While streaming, `assistant.message_delta{message_id, delta_content}` is merged by the harness into ephemeral `delta_batch` frames (flush every 50 ms or 4 KiB).

entries.shows: Wall time of the turn, tokens it used, and the share of input served from the provider's prompt cache.
entries.source: Duration = `assistant.turn_end.timestamp − assistant.turn_start.timestamp` joined on `turn_id` (SV). Tokens = Σ `input_tokens + output_tokens` of the `assistant.usage` events received between them; cached share = Σ `cache_read_tokens` / Σ `input_tokens` (fields SV, join INF; whether `input_tokens` already includes cache reads is probe V17).

entries.element: Inline agent card (spawned subagent or teammate)
entries.shows: Kind, name, task, status, current activity, step progress, branch, context %, elapsed time, tokens, model; buttons Open, Message, Stop.
entries.source: Anchored where the parent called `spawn_agent`: `ToolInvocation.tool_call_id` (SV) is stored as `AgentRecord.spawned_by_call`. Fields: status D1, activity D2, step D3, context D5, elapsed D6, tokens D7, task from the board, branch from `Workspace`.
entries.action: Open → focus the agent (client). Message → sets composer target (K3). Stop (two-step) → harness `agent_stop` → `Session::abort()`, then `rpc().sessions().close(..)` once `session.idle` arrives; owned tasks return to `pending`; agent becomes `cancelled`.

entries.shows: Short result of a finished agent; 'Full report' expands it.
entries.source: `TaskResult.summary` (≤ 2 KiB) parsed from the child's final `assistant.message` using the fixed headings SUMMARY / EVIDENCE / CHANGES / RISKS / BLOCKERS; the full text is a blob.
entries.action: 'Full report' fetches `GET /api/blobs/{sha}`.

entries.shows: Plan version, task rows (id, title, owner, dependencies), who approved and when.
entries.source: `PlanVersion{version, markdown, ops, state: approved, decided}` created when the orchestrator called `submit_plan`; rows from its `TaskSpec`s after ids were assigned.
entries.action: Header toggles the row list (client).

entries.shows: Proposed version, reason, '+' rows for added tasks, rows whose dependencies change; Approve / Edit plan / Reject.
entries.source: `PlanVersion` N+1 from the orchestrator's `propose_plan_change` (state `awaiting_approval`). '+' rows = `Add` ops; changed dependencies = `Rewire` ops.
entries.action: Approve → `plan_decide{version, approve}` → board applies ops (`task_created`, `task_changed`) and a `Notify{PlanApproved}` mail reaches the orchestrator via `Session::send(MessageOptions{mode: Enqueue})`. Edit → Plan tab (P1). Reject → `plan_decided{rejected{feedback}}` plus `Notify{PlanRejected}`.

entries.shows: A child's question that reached the user, with choices and a free-text reply.
entries.source: An `Ask` mail. It originates from the harness `ask` tool, or from Copilot's built-in ask-user, which calls the harness `UserInputHandler` with `user_input.requested{question, choices, allow_freeform}` (SV). It reaches the user when the parent calls `ask{forward: <mail id>}`, or when the parent is idle or `InputRequired` and has not answered within 120 s of its next wake.
entries.action: Choice or reply → `answer_ask{mail_id, text}` → `Answer` mail delivered to the asker with `Session::send(… mode: Enqueue)`. If the ask came through `UserInputHandler` and is answered within 60 s, the pending handler returns `UserInputResponse{answer, was_freeform}` (SV) instead; after 60 s the handler has already returned "no answer yet" and the answer goes by `Enqueue`.

entries.shows: Which agent wants to run what, why, in which worktree; Deny / Always allow in this worktree / Allow once; a bar that drains until auto-deny (C27). Like the other cards waiting on the user (C12, and C8 while its agent needs permission) it has an amber left edge; it glows once when it first appears.
entries.source: Created when the SDK calls `PermissionHandler::handle(session_id, request_id, PermissionRequestData{kind, tool_call_id, extra})` (SV). Command text, intention and paths are parsed from `extra` into the generated `PermissionRequestShell{full_command_text, intention, possible_paths, can_offer_session_approval}` (field names SV; the SDK documents that `extra` varies by CLI version, so parsing is probe V6). Worktree = the agent's `Workspace`.
entries.action: Allow once → `PermissionResult::approve_once()` (SV). Always allow in worktree → `PermissionDecision::ApproveForLocation{location_key, …}` (variant SV, `location_key` meaning UNV, probe V11) or, as fallback, a harness rule plus `approve_once`. Deny → `PermissionResult::reject(feedback)` (SV). Decision 10: with no click after 90 s the handler returns `reject("waiting for user approval; you will be told when to retry")`; the card switches to 'Approve & retry', which stores the rule and sends the agent a `Directive` via `Enqueue`.

entries.shows: A message between two agents: sender, recipient, kind, time, delivery state.
entries.source: `MailMessage{from, to, kind, summary, state}`. Shown in the sender's and recipient's transcripts, and in the lead transcript when both parties are in its subtree.

entries.shows: A user message to a non-lead agent and how it was delivered.
entries.source: `Steer` mail. Delivery line = D10 over `DeliveryState`: `held` → `submitted` (when `Session::send` returns its message id, SV) → `in_context{delivery}` when `user.message.delivery` is `idle | steering | queued` (SV). Matching the send's id to `user.message.message_id` is probe V3.

entries.shows: Context compaction: utilisation when it started, tokens before and after, messages removed, and what the summarizer call cost (tokens in, cached, out, duration). A failed compaction shows its error and the failure count toward RT1.
entries.source: `session.compaction_start{trigger, current_tokens, token_limit}` and `session.compaction_complete{success, error, pre_compaction_tokens, post_compaction_tokens, messages_removed, summary_content, compaction_tokens_used{input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, duration}}` (SV), normalized to the `Compaction` EventKind. 'k of 2 failed' = `CopilotBinding.failed_compactions_in_a_row` against RT1 (harness). 'View summary' opens the `summary_content` blob.
entries.action: 'View summary' fetches the `summary_content` blob.

entries.shows: The agent moved to a new Copilot session (generation) after a rescue trigger, which trigger, and the handoff size in tokens.
entries.source: `agent_rotated{from_generation, to_session, trigger: RT1 | RT2 | RT3 | RT4, handoff, handoff_tokens}` (section 4.3). Handoff ≤ 8 KiB = last `compaction_complete.summary_content` (SV field, reused at no extra cost) + owned tasks, mail summaries, private checklist, last assistant message, `git diff --stat`, edited paths. The old session is closed with `rpc().sessions().close` (SV).
entries.action: 'View handoff' fetches the blob.

entries.element: Task brief (top of an agent view)
entries.shows: The instructions the parent gave when spawning, plus what context, tools and workspace the agent got.
entries.source: The spawn `Directive` mail (= `spawn_agent.prompt`). Tools line = the agent's `SessionConfig.available_tools` / `excluded_tools` (SV). Workspace = `SessionConfig.working_directory` (SV).

entries.shows: The agent's own step list; not on the task board.
entries.source: Harness tool `todo_write` (whole-list replace; one writer) → `AgentRecord.scratch`.

entries.shows: Lines changed by one edit, with file name and +/− counts.
entries.source: Triggered by `tool.execution_complete.file_edits[{kind, path}]` (SV). The event carries no line counts, so D9 computes the diff.

entries.shows: The agent's own outstanding question and whether it was forwarded or answered.
entries.source: The agent's `Ask` mail and its `DeliveryState` / linked `Answer`.

entries.shows: Text arriving live.
entries.source: Ephemeral `delta_batch` built from `assistant.message_delta.delta_content` (SV). The caret disappears when `assistant.message` with the same `message_id` arrives. Deltas never enter the durable log.

entries.shows: The agent finished and its result went to the parent.
entries.source: `agent_status{completed}` and the `Notify{AgentCompleted}` mail to the parent.

entries.shows: Why an agent is idle.
entries.source: D1 = idle plus the board: owned tasks that are not ready and the tasks they wait on.

entries.shows: What the focused agent is doing right now.
entries.source: D1 for the focused agent. In the lead view: children that are running or waiting on the user, plus D8.

entries.shows: The only place a lost link is reported: the UI's stream to the harness, or the harness's Copilot CLI process (S6). While it shows, every other element keeps its last known value, stops animating and refuses commands; the panel header shows the seq the state is from.
entries.source: Stream state of `WS /api/runs/{run}/stream`: a `stream.end{reason, last_seq, retryable}` frame or a socket close sets it down. While `retryable`, the client reconnects with `since_seq = last_seq + 1` after 2, 4, 8 and 16 s, then every 30 s; replay follows section 10.2. A CLI exit arrives as a `health` envelope from the supervisor, which resumes sessions on its own (section 4.4).
entries.action: Retry now reconnects immediately. Diagnostics opens the Event log tab (E4). The chevron shows the reason, last seq, resume URL and backoff. Commands clicked while offline are refused with a toast and are never queued.

entries.shows: Time left before the harness auto-denies an open permission request: a thin bar across the top of C13 that drains over the 90 s window. Screen readers get the same time as text ('auto-denies in m:ss'). The bar stops while the connection banner C26 shows and goes away when the request is decided or times out.
entries.source: `PendingPermission{opened_ms, state: open}` from the `Permission(..)` envelope (section 7.5). Time left = `opened_ms` + 90 000 − now, where now is the latest envelope's `ts_ms` plus local time elapsed since it arrived, so a skewed client clock does not move the bar. The harness, not the client, ends the window: it returns `reject(feedback)` and emits `Permission(..)` with `state: timed_out`.

entries.shows: Total uncommitted and committed change across writer worktrees since their base commit.
entries.source: For each writer worktree: `git -C <wt> diff --numstat <base_commit>` plus `git status --porcelain` (untracked files count as added). Recomputed, debounced 1 s, after any `tool.execution_complete` that has non-empty `file_edits` (SV) or comes from a shell tool (shell writes are not listed in `file_edits`, probe V15).
entries.action: Click opens the Worktrees tab.

entries.shows: Messages the user sent that are queued in an agent's Copilot session; Send now / Retract.
entries.source: Mail in state `submitted` not yet seen as `user.message`. On every `pending_messages.modified` the harness calls `rpc().queue().pending_items()` and emits `mail_state` envelopes; queue items carry the send's `message_id` (both SV; the queue namespace is experimental).
entries.action: Send now → `rpc().queue().send_now({id})` with the queue item id from `pending_items()` (SV). Retract → `rpc().queue().withdraw_message{message_id, expected_prompt}` (SV), using the send id and the prompt stored in `DeliveryState::Submitted`.

entries.shows: Which agent the message goes to, with each agent's status.
entries.source: Client list over `AgentRecord`s with D1. Typing `@agent-id ` at the start of the message also sets the target.

entries.shows: How the message will land given the target's state.
entries.source: From D1 of the target and the K5 toggle: idle → 'starts a new turn'; running + steer → 'steers the current turn'; running + queue → 'queued for the next turn'.

entries.shows: Whether a message to a running agent interrupts its current turn.
entries.source: On → `MessageOptions.mode = Some(DeliveryMode::Immediate)`; the echo arrives as `user.message.delivery = steering`. Off → `Enqueue`, echo `queued`. Default on for user → running agent. To an idle agent the mode does not matter; the echo is `idle`.

entries.shows: Text to send.
entries.source: Becomes `MessageOptions.prompt`. Mail from agents is wrapped in a `<mail …>` envelope and `display_prompt` carries the human-readable text.
entries.action: Enter sends (K11).

entries.shows: Attach files or images.
entries.source: `MessageOptions.attachments`.

entries.shows: Plans and re-plans wait for user approval (always on; decision 6).
entries.source: The orchestrator starts in plan mode with `MessageOptions.agent_mode = Plan` or `rpc().mode().set(…)` (SV) and gets only read-only tools plus `submit_plan`.

entries.shows: Model of the target agent's session.
entries.source: `SessionConfig.model` at creation (required with BYOK per docs); changed with `Session::set_model`; observed as `session.model_change{new_model}`.

entries.shows: lead / teammate / subagent.
entries.source: `AgentRecord.kind`.

entries.shows: Sends the message.
entries.source: To the orchestrator → command `user_message` → `Session::send` (SV). To any other agent → command `send_mail{to, kind: steer, urgency}` → mailbox → `Session::send`. Acknowledged only after the log write commits.

entries.shows: For the focused agent: turns in its current generation, steps in the current turn, output rate while it streams, tokens and cache share, and its context ring (H6).
entries.source: Turns = count of `assistant.turn_start` (SV) in the current generation. Steps = D13 spans since the latest `assistant.turn_start`. Output rate = `assistant.message_delta` characters per second over the last 5 s, converted with the model's tokens-per-character estimate; hidden when the agent is not streaming. Tokens and cache share = D7.

entries.shows: How many agents are running, blocked on the user, idle.
entries.source: Counts over D1.

entries.shows: Name, task, status, activity, context meter, model, generation; Message and Stop.
entries.source: `AgentRecord` + D1, D2, D5. Meter ticks sit at D11 (the agent's `background_compaction_threshold`) and at `buffer_exhaustion_threshold` 0.95 (fields SV). Generation = `CopilotBinding.generation`; it changes only on the rescue triggers RT1–RT4 of section 4.3.
entries.action: Row focuses the agent. Message → K3. Stop → as C8.

entries.shows: Long-lived teammates versus fire-and-forget subagents.
entries.source: `AgentRecord.kind`: `orchestrator` and `teammate` versus `quick`.

entries.shows: All tasks with status glyph and owner.
entries.source: Board projection with D4.
entries.action: 'Open board' switches tab.

entries.shows: Elapsed time since the run started, agents and how many are live, tokens and prompt-cache share across all agents, and the total time at least one item was waiting on the user.
entries.source: Elapsed = now − `ts_ms` of the run's first envelope. Agents and live = S2. Tokens and cache share = Σ D7 over all agents. Waiting on you = length of the union of all needs-you spans (D13); 'open now' = D8.

entries.shows: One lane per agent from spawn to now. Bars show what the agent was doing (model, tool, waiting, needs you); an amber underline marks time an item from that lane waited on the user; diamonds mark compaction, rotation, steering and messages; the teal line is now.
entries.source: D13 spans per agent, laid out on one time axis. 'Whole run' runs from the first envelope to the next 10-minute mark after now; 'Last 10 min' ends at the next minute. Spans narrower than 2 px are drawn 2 px wide.
entries.action: Clicking a lane opens that agent. Hovering a span shows its label, start, end and duration. The Whole run / Last 10 min switch is client-only.

entries.element: Turn steps of the focused agent
entries.shows: The focused agent's current turn, or its last one, as steps: model calls, tool calls, blocking waits and approval waits, each with its duration and its position inside the turn.
entries.source: D13 spans from the agent's latest `assistant.turn_start` to its `assistant.turn_end`, or to now while the turn runs. After an orchestrator turn ends, its waiting span is shown as the last step. Turn number = count of `assistant.turn_start` in the agent's current generation. Tool labels: `tool_title`, else `tool_name` with its main argument.

entries.shows: Approved plan version and done / total.
entries.source: Latest approved `PlanVersion.version`; counts over tasks not in `proposed`.
entries.action: Graph / List switch (client).

entries.shows: Tasks as nodes, dependencies as edges, proposed tasks dashed.
entries.source: Client layout over the board: layer = longest path along `blocked_by`; edges = `blocked_by`; node label = D4.
entries.action: Clicking a node switches to List.

entries.shows: Tasks grouped by display status, with owner, dependencies and acceptance text.
entries.source: Board `Task{id, title, owner, blocked_by, acceptance, status}` with D4.

entries.shows: The plan markdown and its task table.
entries.source: `PlanVersion.markdown`, stored by the harness (source of truth). Mirrored into the orchestrator's Copilot session with `rpc().plan().update(…)` (SV) so the model's native plan context matches; never read back as truth.

entries.shows: Every plan version with state and decision time.
entries.source: `Plan.versions[*]{version, state, authored_by, decided}`.

entries.shows: Decision controls for the open version.
entries.source: Commands `plan_decide` and `plan_edit` (see C11).
entries.action: Edit opens the markdown and task table for editing; saving sets `user_edited = true` on the version.

entries.shows: Filter by message kind.
entries.source: Client filter on `MailKind`.

entries.shows: Sender, recipient, kind, time, text, delivery state, seq.
entries.source: `MailMessage` with D10 and the envelope `seq` of its last state change.

entries.shows: Highest committed sequence number and whether this client is caught up.
entries.source: Last `seq` committed by the single log writer; 'in sync' when the client's last received seq equals it.

entries.shows: Bytes used by the run's log.
entries.source: Σ sizes of segments, snapshots and blobs from `GET /api/runs/{run}/log/stats` (filesystem metadata, refreshed on `snapshot_written` and every 10 s).

entries.shows: How many envelopes the UI holds in memory (cap 4,096).
entries.source: Client counter. When full, the oldest envelopes are dropped from memory; scrolling back re-fetches them (C1).

entries.shows: How often this client or the harness's Copilot reader fell behind, and where recovery started.
entries.source: Client: count of `resync` frames received. Harness: each `cursor_status: expired` from the single `event_log().read` loop (SV) is recorded as `resync`, and each gap in ephemeral events (which cannot be replayed) as `health`; with the `subscribe()` fallback, each `Lagged(n)` (SV) is recorded as `health{lagged: n}`.

entries.shows: D5 for every agent, with ticks at D11 and 95%.
entries.source: Latest `session.usage_info` per agent (see H6).

entries.shows: Files in the run's log directory.
entries.source: Listing from `GET /api/runs/{run}/log/stats`: segments roll at 64 MiB or 200,000 events; snapshot every 10,000 events, last 3 kept; payloads over 8 KiB go to blobs.

entries.shows: Last 10 envelopes on this client's stream.
entries.source: Columns: `seq`, agent, type, detail. Type = `Origin::Copilot.event_type` (the SDK wire name, e.g. `tool.execution_start`) or the harness `EventKind` (e.g. `task_changed`). Includes ephemeral `delta_batch` frames, which are not stored.

entries.shows: Commit every worktree was created from.
entries.source: `Workspace::Worktree.base_commit`, recorded when the harness ran `git worktree add`.

entries.shows: Status letter, path and +/− per file.
entries.source: `git -C <wt> diff --numstat <base_commit>` and `git status --porcelain`.

entries.shows: Files of the chosen worktree, with each changed file's status letter and a dot on collapsed folders that hold changes. Chips pick an agent worktree or the main checkout.
entries.source: `GET /api/runs/{run}/worktrees` for branch, base commit and changed files (G1, G2). The full file list is `git -C <wt> ls-files` plus untracked files from `git status --porcelain`, served in the same response.
entries.action: Clicking a folder expands it (client); clicking a file opens it in the editor (W3).

entries.shows: Every changed file across agent worktrees, grouped by branch, with +/− counts.
entries.source: Same data as G2.
entries.action: Click opens the file from that worktree.

entries.shows: Open files, the active file's path, worktree, size and +/− counts, and a 'read-only' badge (the UI never writes files; agents do). Shows '<agent> is editing' while that agent's running turn has edited the file.
entries.source: Tabs are client state. 'is editing' = the path is in `file_edits` of a `tool.execution_complete` (SV) in the agent's current turn, and D1 is running.
entries.action: Tabs switch or close files (client).

entries.shows: The file as it is in the chosen worktree, highlighted, with gutter marks on lines the agent's latest edit added or changed.
entries.source: `GET /api/runs/{run}/worktrees/{agent}/file?path=` returns `{path, rev, size, content}`; files over 256 KiB come back as a blob hash read through `/api/blobs/{sha256}`. Gutter marks come from the latest per-edit diff D9 of that path.

entries.element: File / Diff switch and diff view
entries.shows: The latest per-edit diff of the file.
entries.source: D9 blobs for the path, newest first.
entries.action: The File / Diff switch is client-only.

entries.shows: Opens the worktree file in the user's local editor.
entries.source: Placeholder in the mockup; a desktop shell would hand the worktree path to the OS.

entries.shows: One card per background shell: description, command, owner agent, status, elapsed time, pid, attached or detached, and a listening port when one is seen.
entries.source: Per agent session, `tasks().list()` (SV, experimental) returns entries tagged by `type`. `type: "shell"` entries parse as `TaskShellInfo{id, command, description, status, execution_mode, attachment_mode, pid, log_path, started_at, completed_at}` (SV). The harness re-lists a session when `session.background_tasks_changed` arrives (empty payload, SV) and diffs the result into `bg_job_started` / `bg_job_exited`, keyed by (agent, task id), so finished jobs outlive the session, a rotation and a CLI restart (INF). Elapsed = now − `started_at`, frozen at `completed_at`. The port is parsed from the output ('listening on …:N') and is only a hint (CLIENT). `type: "agent"` entries (`TaskAgentInfo`) are not shown here, because the harness spawns its own subagents.
entries.action: More output expands the tail (B2). Message opens the composer to the owner.

entries.shows: The last lines a background shell printed: 3 on a running card, 2 on a failed one, 14 when expanded.
entries.source: Attached shells stream `tool.shell_output{tool_call_id, sequence, stream, text}` (SV). It is ephemeral (not persisted, not replayed to late subscribers), so the harness appends each chunk to a per-job tail blob capped at 64 KiB and forwards `bg_job_output` frames that are drawn but never stored, like `delta_batch` (INF). On first paint or after a gap the tail is refilled from `tasks().get_progress({id})` → `TaskShellProgress{pid, recent_output}` (SV). Detached shells have no stream; the harness tails `log_path` (SV field). Whether `tool.shell_output` keeps flowing after the starting tool call has returned is probe V19.
entries.action: Full output: `GET /api/runs/{run}/jobs/{job}/output`.

entries.surface: Status bar, composer, activity bar, agents
entries.shows: How many background shells are running: status bar item, composer strip, activity bar badge, and a per-agent count on the sidebar, agent rows and task cards.
entries.source: Jobs in the harness projection whose D12 status is Running or Idle, grouped by owner. Finished jobs are not counted.
entries.action: Click opens the Background view in the sidebar.

entries.shows: Stop on a running job (two clicks) and Clear on the Finished group.
entries.source: Stop sends `job_stop{job_id}` → `tasks().cancel({id})` (SV) on the owner's session. The job ends as Stopped and the owner gets a `Notify` mail. If `cancelled` is false and the job is detached with a `pid`, the harness kills the process group (INF). Clear sends `job_clear` → `tasks().remove({id})` (SV) per finished job; the harness keeps its records and output blobs. `agent_stop` cancels the agent's running jobs before `abort()` (INF).
entries.action: Stop: the first click arms, the second cancels. Clear: hides finished jobs from the tab.

entries.shows: In the owner's transcript: the shell call that started a background job, its live status, elapsed time and last output lines.
entries.source: The `tool.execution_start` row (C5) whose `shell_tool_info.display_command` matches a new `TaskShellInfo.command` with `execution_mode: background` (SV fields). The harness links the call and the job through `bg_job_started.tool_call_id` (INF). That `TaskShellInfo.id` can be matched to the tool call is probe V19; the fallback is command text plus start time. A sync shell moved to the background with `tasks().promote_to_background({id})` (SV) gets the same card.
entries.action: Show in Background opens the tab at this job. Stop as in B4.

entries.shows: A divider in the owner's transcript when a job leaves Running: exit code, duration, and how the owner was told.
entries.source: `bg_job_exited{job, status, exit_code, duration_ms, tail}`. The exit code comes from `ToolExecutionCompleteContentShellExit{shell_id, exit_code, output_preview}` (SV type) when one arrives, else it shows as unknown; which event carries it for a background shell is probe V19. The harness then sends the owner a `Notify` mail with the exit code and the last 20 lines (`Enqueue` when mid-turn, a new turn when idle), so agents never poll their jobs (INF). copilot-cli #4946 reports an HTTP 400 after a background shell completion; V19 checks it on each BYOK route.

entries.shows: Which sidebar view is showing: Sessions, Task board, Plan, Mailbox, Background, Worktrees or Event log.
entries.source: Client state.
entries.action: Click switches the sidebar to that view; clicking the active view hides the sidebar.

entries.shows: Mail needing attention.
entries.source: Asks to the user not yet answered + user-sent mail still `held` or `submitted`.

entries.shows: Plan versions awaiting approval.
entries.source: Count of `PlanVersion` in `awaiting_approval`.

entries.shows: Run names, the repository 'payments-api', branch names, model names, file paths, code, message text, token counts and timings.
entries.source: Invented to exercise the wiring above. None of it was produced by an API.

entries.shows: running · needs_permission · needs_answer · waiting_on_agents · idle · starting · rotating · completed · failed · cancelled · crashed
entries.source: starting: record exists, session not started. running: an `assistant.turn_start` (SV) seen with no later `session.idle` (SV). needs_permission: running and the harness holds an unresolved `PermissionHandler` call. needs_answer: `AgentStatus::InputRequired` (open Ask with a wait, or a pending `UserInputHandler` call). idle: last `session.idle{aborted: false}` and nothing open. waiting_on_agents: idle with at least one child running or needs_*. rotating: a rescue trigger fired and the agent is between its safe point and the new session's start (section 4.3). Terminal states come from `AgentStatus`.

entries.shows: One line saying what the agent is doing.
entries.source: Latest `assistant.intent{intent}` (SV) since the last `assistant.turn_start`; else the private checklist item `in_progress`; else the last `tool_title` / `tool_name`. Cut to 80 chars.

entries.shows: Progress through the private checklist.
entries.source: Y = number of checklist items; X = completed items + 1 if one is `in_progress`. Hidden when the agent has no checklist.

entries.shows: Done · In progress · Needs answer · Blocked · Ready · Waiting · Proposed · Failed · Cancelled
entries.source: `completed` → Done; `in_progress` → In progress; `input_required` → Needs answer; `blocked{…}` → Blocked; `proposed` → Proposed; `pending` with every `blocked_by` completed and no lease → Ready; `pending` otherwise → Waiting (on the unmet ids).

entries.shows: Share of the context window in use.
entries.source: `round(100 × current_tokens / token_limit)` from the latest `session.usage_info` of the agent's current generation. Unknown after a new generation until its first `session.usage_info`; unchanged by a resume.

entries.shows: Time since the agent was spawned.
entries.source: Now − `ts_ms` of the `agent_spawned` envelope; frozen at the terminal status.

entries.shows: Tokens used by the agent across all its generations, and the share of input served from the provider's prompt cache.
entries.source: Σ (`input_tokens` + `output_tokens`) over its `assistant.usage` events; cached share = Σ `cache_read_tokens` / Σ `input_tokens` (probe V17 settles whether `input_tokens` includes cache reads; if not, the denominator is `input_tokens + cache_read_tokens`).

entries.shows: Items waiting on the user.
entries.source: Open Asks addressed to the user + `PlanVersion`s in `awaiting_approval` + permission requests held by the harness (including ones auto-denied and waiting for 'Approve & retry').

entries.shows: Lines changed by one tool call.
entries.source: For each `file_edits[].path` after `tool.execution_complete`: read the file in the agent's worktree, store it as a content-addressed blob, diff against the previous stored version of that path (or `git show <base_commit>:<path>`; empty for new files) with the `similar` crate. Counts = inserted / deleted lines.

entries.shows: How a message reached its recipient.
entries.source: `held` → 'Held until <agent> is idle'; `submitted` → 'Queued in <agent>'s session'; `in_context{steering}` → 'Steered into the current turn'; `in_context{queued}` → 'Delivered at the turn boundary'; `in_context{idle}` → 'Delivered; started a turn'; `answered`, `withdrawn`, `expired`, `failed` as named. The `delivery` values come from `UserMessageDelivery` (SV).

entries.shows: Where background compaction starts for this agent, as a share of its window.
entries.source: `min(0.80, 250000 / window)`, where `window` is the context size declared by the agent's BYOK provider profile (`context_window_tokens`), known before the session is created and also passed as `ProviderConfig.max_prompt_tokens` (SV). The result is set as `InfiniteSessionConfig.background_compaction_threshold` (field SV, formula INF, section 4.2). If the first `session.usage_info.token_limit` differs, the harness logs `health` and uses the smaller value from the next generation on. 0.80 for a 200K window, 0.625 for 400K, 0.25 for 1M.

entries.shows: Running · Idle · Exited N · Failed (exit N) · Stopped · Lost
entries.source: From `TaskShellInfo.status` (SV): `running` → Running; `idle` → Idle; `completed` → Exited 0, or Exited N when a non-zero code is known; `failed` → Failed (exit N); `cancelled` → Stopped. A job the harness still holds as running but that is missing from `tasks().list()` → Lost (INF). Exit codes as in B6.

entries.shows: model · tool · waiting · needs you, plus point events
entries.source: Per agent, in `seq` order: `assistant.turn_start` (SV) opens a model span; `tool.execution_start` (SV) closes it and opens a tool span keyed by `tool_call_id`; `tool.execution_complete` (SV) closes that and reopens a model span; `assistant.turn_end` (SV) closes whatever is open. A blocking `ask` or `wait` tool is shown as waiting. A permission the harness holds is needs-you from its `permission` request to its decision; it stays open after an auto-deny until the user decides. An Ask forwarded to the user and a plan version awaiting approval are needs-you on the orchestrator's lane until `mail_state` answered or `plan_decided`. Between turns, an orchestrator with live children is waiting. Point events: `compaction`, `agent_rotated`, `mail_created`, `user_message`.
